_about: Screenshots of the game for the guide (data/docs/game.md), the tutorial and the encyclopedia - shown where their text has ![caption](shot:id). tests/doc_shots.gd sets each moment up; tools/doc_shots.py takes them, draws the notes over them (an infographic: labels with arrows, boxes, numbered steps - in 1920 x 1080 screen units) and saves data/docs/shots/<id>.jpg. 'sources': the files the picture shows - when one changes, the shot is out of date (test_doc_shots) until taken again.

space_hud.caption: Flying in space: your gauge (hull, shields, fuel), the minimap, your objective, the console (event log and loading tabs) and the toolbar.

notes.text: Hull (red) in its shield ring (blue)
The system and who holds it
Minimap: ships, stations, wrecks in grey
Your objective
You - click space to fly
Console tabs: the event log, loading
Event log: what just happened (L hides it)
Toolbar: weapons and systems, keys 1-9
Fuel: the amber outer ring

space_combat.caption: A fight: click an enemy to attack it - your guns fire on their own while it's in range.

mining.caption: Mining: a prospected rock's veins glowing on it, the laser cutting one; the readout holds the rock's mix, the vein's heat in its green band and the resonance building.

notes.text: The rock you're mining, and the ore left in it
The ore comes to your hold
The vein's heat: keep it in the green

damage.caption: Near death: afflictions under the bars (the self-repair frozen first), the screen failing, cracks across the glass.

notes.text: Afflictions round the gauge: hover one
Cracks and static near death

salvage.caption: Salvage: with a Salvage Rig fitted, click a wreck - your ship cuts it apart and the salvage drifts out.

signal_site.caption: A signal source: a stranded ship calling for help. The panel says what it is and how hard.

nav_beacon.caption: The navigation beacon beside the star: right-click it to scan it - you get the system's navigation report.

notes.text: The nav beacon - right-click it to scan
On the radar too

station_market.caption: The market: a tab per category, what the station pays and asks, the galactic average, supply and demand - and the selected good on the right.

notes.text: A tab per category
Sell / buy prices, the galactic average
Supply and demand
Buy and sell here - and where it sells best

station_outfitting.caption: Outfitting: a tab per kind of fitting; click one to see it - its picture, and what it would change, before and after.

notes.text: Click one to see it
A tab per kind of fitting
Quality grades
Before and after: what it would change

station_weapons.caption: Weapons in sizes: pick a size, buy one - it goes on a free hardpoint that takes it; fitted ones listed by kind and size.

notes.text: Sizes XS to XXL
Fitted: by kind and size
What it adds to your firepower

station_shipyard.caption: The shipyard: a tab per class, cheapest first - each ship's hull, shields, speed and hold beside how they compare with yours.

notes.text: A tab per class
Green: how much better than your ship
Buy - your old ship is traded in

station_missions.caption: Missions: jobs on offer (the better ones need a better standing) and the ones you've taken.

station_reputation.caption: Reputation: where you stand with every empire, and how it rises and falls.

station_service.caption: The repair service: the technicians' evaluation - the hull, each damaged part and its faults, each priced; repair one, a part, or everything.

notes.text: Each item: time, your cost, theirs
Everything at once

computer_inventory.caption: The Ship Computer's inventory: your ship by its areas, the hold, what you carry on foot, the toolbar and your automaton.

notes.text: Your ship by its areas
The toolbar: keys 1-9
The hold - drag stacks to arrange them
Your automaton's gear

computer_map.caption: The sector map: stations, planets, ships and your objective in this system.

probes.caption: The probe scanner: probes on the map round a stretch of the system, the signatures they read - located, or a circle where they might be; the gold handle above them moves them all.

notes.text: Probes: drag them, the wheel sets the reach
Drag the handle: all move
What they found, strongest first

computer_galaxy.caption: The galaxy map with its trade layer: every system and who holds it, and the best trade runs you know of.

notes.text: Who holds each system
Green: a trade run and its profit a unit
The best runs you know of

computer_tech.caption: The Tech Tree: upgrades bought with drachmas and Data Cores.

computer_quest.caption: The quest journal: the chapters, your objective and everything said so far.

industry.caption: Industry: the fabricator's recipes with what you have of each input, the queue at work on the right.

notes.text: A recipe: what it takes, what it sells for
The queue at work

surface_walk.caption: On a planet: you by your ship on the landing pad, Kilon Alios beside it - a yellow triangle marks someone with something for you.

notes.text: Kilon Alios - click him to talk
You, by your ship - click it to take off
A Minoan palace

field_inventory.caption: The Field Computer on foot: you, your automaton's equipment and what you carry.

surface_map.caption: The planet map: what you've explored, its layers, and the planet's facts.

repair_bay.caption: The Repair Bay: the engines open on the table - a crack half welded, a leak, a wrecked cell waiting for a spare.

notes.text: The parts: how well each works, ! faults found, ? untraced
The operating table: the part opened up
Vitals: pulse, heat, pressure
Tools and scan modes
Spare parts you carry

surgery.caption: The automaton on the table: its arm's anatomy - a tear in the biceps, and incisions held open down to a bleeding artery, a burnt nerve and a fractured bone.

notes.text: An incision: the layers beneath
The four layers
A surgeon's tools
The part's region of the body

archive.caption: The Archive: every book of the game in one window - here the Pilot's Guide open at the Repair Bay.

notes.text: Search every book at once
The shelf: six books
Where you are: book and chapter
Back / Forward, like a browser

nav_report.caption: A navigation report: the system's stations, gates, planets and moons and its traffic - a copy in your hold to sell in other systems.

notes.text: Stations and jump gates
Planets and moons - landable in green
Ships: hostile, friendly, by trade
Sell the copy elsewhere: the further, the more

skill_book.caption: The Spell Book (K): your level and points, every skill with its rank - the one under the mouse in full on the right.

notes.text: A point learns a skill, or raises its rank
Drag an icon onto the toolbar - or hover it and press 1-9
The skill under the mouse, in full
Your level, experience and points

skills_fight.caption: A fight on foot with skills: the Aegis Dome up, the eidola out, Keraunos coming down on a pirate.

notes.text: Keraunos: the thunderbolt leaps from enemy to enemy
An eidolon - a spectral fighter of yours
You, inside the Aegis Dome
Skills on the toolbar (4-9) - your level over it

space3d.caption: 3D space (preview): an ocean world below - real procedural ground from orbit down - its clouds and air; your ship from behind, the markers and the flight panel.

notes.text: Real ground, seen from orbit: seas, coasts, clouds
The virtual stick: the mouse steers
Speed, throttle, the drive, altitude, target
The system and its owner

space3d_ground.caption: Low over the same world: its sky, clouds overhead, sea and coast - the ground finer the closer you are.

notes.text: Its own sky: air and clouds
Coast and sea - finer the lower you fly
The plumes follow the throttle

space3d_foot.caption: On foot on the ocean world: its own plants and animals, boulders, your health, the sights - and your ship's distance.

notes.text: Under the sights: its name and health
A predator - its own species on each world
Your health: it comes back after a while
Your ship: E beside it to board

space3d_fight.caption: Pirate raiders: the target's shields and hull, where to aim to hit it, your lasers.

notes.text: The raider: its shields and hull on the panel
Ring: aim there to hit it (the lead)
Your shields, hull and credits
Your lasers' bolts

space3d_hangar.caption: Docked: the station's hangar - your ship on the pad, the crew, the terminals along the back wall.

notes.text: Your ship on the pad
Terminals: market, outfitting, missions, repairs, saving
The station's crew
